image_title: Effort and Utilization Metrics by Quarter
summary: The table presents metrics related to effort and utilization for three quarters ending on September 30, 2024, June 30, 2024, and September 30, 2023. It compares onsite and offshore effort percentages, as well as utilization rates including and excluding trainees. Notably, offshore effort remains consistently higher than onsite effort across all quarters. Utilization rates, both including and excluding trainees, show a slight decline over the observed periods.
table_rows: Utilization Including trainees: Sep 30 2024 = 84.3, Jun 30 2024 = 83.9, Sep 30 2023 = 80.4
Utilization Excluding trainees: Sep 30 2024 = 85.9, Jun 30 2024 = 85.3, Sep 30 2023 = 81.8
